competences.description: Attacks the enemy and decreases its Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance. While under the Thunderer state, the attack inflicts damage that increases according to your MAX HP, and attacks additionally with lower damage to enemies of the same attribute as the target.

Attacks all enemies to recover the HP by 30% of the inflicted damage, and decreases their Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance. While under the Thunderer state, the attack inflicts damage that increases according to your MAX HP and provokes all enemies for 2 turns.

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Increases the damage dealt to the enemy by 10%, up to 50%, whenever you receive damage from the enemy. If you receive damage while under the Thunderer state, you reflect 30% of the received damage and increase the duration of the Thunderer state by 1 turn with a 50% chance. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Return a % of the incoming damage to the attacker when attacked.

competences.description: Falls under the Thunderer state that enhances your skills for 3 turns and instantly gains another turn. While under the Thunderer state, your MAX HP increases by 30%. Once the Thunderer state ends, you become stunned for 1 turn. In addition, decreases the skill cooldown of [The Dark Thunderer] by 2 turns each when you are not under the Thunderer state.
